instruction: Cinematic full shot of an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the trainer in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) braces herself, holding up a red focus mitt with her left hand. On the right, the boxer in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing away, fully extending her right arm to strike the mitt with her black glove. The background features hanging black punching bags under cool, overhead gym lighting.
elements: R1 braces herself while holding up a red focus mitt for R2 to strike
R2 fully extends her right arm to punch the mitt held by R1
R1 is the trainer receiving the strike on the mitt while R2 is the boxer delivering the punch
The red focus mitt is on R1's left hand
R2 wears a black glove on the punching hand
The scene is an indoor boxing ring
